Technical Note - Exact simulation of the ﬁrst passage time of
Brownian motion to a symmetric linear boundary
Jong Mun Lee, Taeho Lee
July 14, 2020
Abstract
We state an exact simulation scheme for the ﬁrst passage time of a Brownian motion to a symmetric linear
boundary. This note summarizes a part of Chapter 4 in [1] which is the unpublished doctoral dissertation of Jong Mun
Lee.
Keywords: Brownian motion, hitting time simulation, exact simulation, linear boundary

Algorithm
Now we write down our algorithm to sample τa,b. We divide our algorithm into two phases. In Algorithm 2, we decide
whether τa,b is ﬁnite or not. And in Algorithm 3, we sample τa,b under the condition [τa,b < ∞]. In Algorithm 2 and
Algorithm 3, we write C(N), F (N) to denote the partial sums of Ca,b and fa,b(t), respectively.
